source_title: Can someone help verify these speeds I'm getting from an LLM run on my phone?
source_text:
So about a month ago I had created \[a very rudimentary test of models running on Edge devices\](https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/comments/1hft45b/list\_of\_smalledge\_models\_i\_tested\_without\_a\_gpu/) (i.e. potatoes like my AMD machine without a GPU). Fast forward to today when I was finally able to compile and run llama.cpp on my phone (a Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra) based on \[this blog post at Qualcomm.com\](https://www.qualcomm.com/developer/blog/2024/11/introducing-new-opn-cl-gpu-backend-llama-cpp-for-qualcomm-adreno-gpu) . The result was....underwhelming :/

What I'm getting makes me question if the GPU of the phone is used at all. So, was wondering, if anyone out there had installed / run a version of llama.cpp on their phones (but without all this Adreno GPU "speedups" that I'm apparently getting) and if yes, are you be able to run \`Mistral-NeMo-Minitron-8B-Instruct-Q4\_0\` and verify the speeds? (I'm getting <2 tokens/sec with this model, for reference on my GPU-less AMD I was getting 6 tokens/sec)
